verdict.rationale: EFTPS publicly states its main identity walls before you begin. Enrollment goes through IRS validation, which takes up to five business days, and then a PIN arrives by U.S. Mail in 5–7 business days. Login.gov or ID.me sign-in with MFA has been mandatory since October 19, 2023, and new individual enrollments are closed, so the service is business and tax-professional only. These facts are scattered across pages rather than set out as one exact, ordered pre-flow checklist. missing for 10: a consolidated step-by-step list of account/credential/proofing requirements, a statement of what ID.me/Login.gov identity proofing actually entails, the enrollment data you must have ready (e.g., EIN or bank details), and hands-on corroboration that no undisclosed steps surface mid-flow.
